title: Island Electric Services
structure:
Topbar: 34px circular back button (inline-styled div, navy-100 background, 16px navy-700 chevron-left svg) then h1 "Island Electric Services". No .top-right. Sidebar active item "Accounting"; .side-foot "TR" / "Tracey Reid" / "Treasurer & Accountant".

.content contains THREE children in order:
(1) div.detail-head (flex, gap 18, margin-bottom 20):
  a. div.hero-card (flex:1, navy gradient, radius 16, padding 20). div.hero-top = wrapper div with div.hero-name "Island Electric Services" and div.hero-sub "Electrical contractor · Owen Grant · (876) 555 0110", plus a right-hand inline-styled green pill (10.5px/700, green-700 on #DCFCE7, padding 5px 11px, radius 20) reading "Active". Then div.hero-stats with FOUR div.hero-stat (.hs-v over .hs-l): "$142,300" / "Paid YTD"; "$8,500" / "Currently owed"; "11" / "Jobs completed"; "Feb 2025" / "Vendor since".
  b. div.action-stack (240px) with TWO div.stack-btn only: .primary "Record new bill" (plus svg), .outline "Edit vendor" (pencil svg).
(2) a bare div.info-panel-head used as a standalone section heading with inline style margin-bottom:12px, text "Bill history" (Poppins 13px, navy-900, 600) — it is NOT inside an .info-panel.
(3) table.data-table with thead>tr of FOUR th: Reference | Amount | Date | Status. tbody has FOUR tr, second td always class num-cell:
  1. "Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting" — "$8,500" — "Sep 3, 2026" — div.status-badge with INLINE amber override (background:var(--amber-100); color:var(--amber-700)) reading "Unpaid".
  2. "Perimeter fence lighting repair" — "$14,200" — "Aug 20, 2026" — div.status-badge.active "Paid Aug 22".
  3. "Clubhouse panel inspection" — "$9,650" — "Aug 5, 2026" — div.status-badge.active "Paid Aug 5".
  4. "Service Gate lighting upgrade" — "$31,400" — "Jun 12, 2026" — div.status-badge.active "Paid Jun 15".
No action column, no totals row, no pagination; the table ends .content.
domain_needs: vendor.name "Island Electric Services" (topbar h1 and hero-name)
vendor.slug "island-electric" (route /accounting/vendors/island-electric — slug is shorter than the display name)
vendor.category "Electrical contractor"
vendor.contact_name "Owen Grant"
vendor.phone "(876) 555 0110" (parenthesised area code — different format from resident screen 38)
hero-sub composition: category · contact_name · phone joined with " · "
vendor.status "Active" (green pill)

vendor.paid_ytd = $142,300 — DERIVED: sum of vendor bills marked paid within the current year. NOTE the four rows drawn sum to only 14,200 + 9,650 + 31,400 = $55,250 paid, so the bill history table is a partial/recent list, not the full YTD set
vendor.currently_owed = $8,500 — DERIVED: sum of unpaid bills; equals the single "Unpaid" row exactly
vendor.jobs_completed = 11 — DERIVED count of completed jobs/bills (again exceeds the 4 rows drawn)
vendor.vendor_since = Feb 2025, rendered "Mon YYYY"

vendor_bill.reference — free text, may embed a ticket number ("Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting") or be a plain description ("Perimeter fence lighting repair", "Clubhouse panel inspection", "Service Gate lighting upgrade")
vendor_bill.ticket_id — nullable FK; row 1 links to Ticket #1042 which also appears on resident screen 38
vendor_bill.amount (8500, 14200, 9650, 31400) rendered "$X,XXX" with no decimals
vendor_bill.bill_date rendered "Mon D, YYYY" ("Sep 3, 2026", "Aug 20, 2026", "Aug 5, 2026", "Jun 12, 2026")
vendor_bill.status enum: unpaid | paid — unpaid renders amber, paid renders green
vendor_bill.paid_on — only set when paid; badge text is "Paid " + paid_on formatted "Mon D" with NO year ("Paid Aug 22", "Paid Aug 5", "Paid Jun 15")
payment lag is visible and must be storable separately from bill_date: Aug 20 → Paid Aug 22 (2 days), Aug 5 → Paid Aug 5 (same day), Jun 12 → Paid Jun 15 (3 days)
bill history sort order: bill_date DESCENDING (Sep 3, Aug 20, Aug 5, Jun 12)
vendor actions: record new bill, edit vendor
accounting_notes: This is the accounts-payable sub-ledger for one vendor. Hero: "Paid YTD $142,300" and "Currently owed $8,500". The "Currently owed" figure ties exactly to the one Unpaid row in Bill history — Ticket #1042 — Gate lighting, $8,500, dated Sep 3, 2026 — so currently_owed = SUM(unpaid bill amounts) and must reconcile to this vendor's balance in the Accounts Payable control account. The visible paid rows total $55,250 ($14,200 + $9,650 + $31,400), which does NOT equal Paid YTD $142,300 and does not have to: only four bills are drawn while "Jobs completed" says 11, so the table is a truncated recent-history view and the hero totals are computed over the full bill set, not the rows on screen — do not derive the hero stats from the displayed rows. Each bill is a credit to Accounts Payable / debit to the relevant expense (electrical repairs & maintenance) on bill_date; each payment is a debit to AP / credit to bank on paid_on, and the badge encodes that settlement date separately ("Paid Aug 22" against a bill dated Aug 20, "Paid Aug 5" same-day, "Paid Jun 15" against Jun 12). The unpaid $8,500 is the only open AP item and is the same work as resident ticket #1042 on screen 38, so the ticket → bill → payment chain must be traceable in both directions. No account codes, trial balance or ageing buckets are printed on this screen; ageing of the $8,500 would run from Sep 3, 2026.
